description:
إحنا داخلين تحدي ناسا Space Apps 2026 في مشروع (اللهب في انعدام الجاذبية) عشان ننافس ونعمل مشروع جامد.

​أنا الباحثة ومحللة البيانات، ومحتاجة معايا:

• مصمم UI/UX: يصمم لوحة تحكم (Dashboard) تخطف العين.

• مبرمج Web: يحول التصميم والداتا لموقع تفاعلي ذكي.

​هنشتغل أونلاين بسلاسة، والتواصل الرئيسي هيبدأ على الجروب وميتنجز زوم. الخطة كاملة وتوزيع المهام هنظبطها أول ما نتجمع.

​لو عايز تعمل شغل يفرق وتنافس بجد، انضم لينا ويلا نكسر الدنيا! 🚀✨
summary: Project Raven Flies (اللهب في السقوط الحر) is an interactive safety platform and reference guide designed for astronauts and aerospace engineers before space missions. The website compiles decades of NASA’s microgravity combustion experiments, featuring in-depth comparisons with historic space incidents including Apollo 1, Apollo 13, and the Mir space station fire. By analyzing flame behavior in zero-gravity and highlighting critical preventive protocols, our platform equips future crews with vital insights to avoid and manage fire disasters in space.
details: - What it does & How it works: The platform serves as a comprehensive digital dashboard tracking NASA's microgravity fire experiments over the years. It provides structured comparative data analysis between controlled combustion tests and major historic space disasters (Apollo 1, Apollo 13, and Mir), translating complex safety data into an intuitive, accessible interface. - Benefits & Impact: Acts as a vital pre-flight safety manual and reference tool for astronauts and engineers, helping them understand fire risks, recognize hazard patterns, and implement preventive safety measures during space exploration. - Technologies Used: Developed using modern web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to deliver interactive data comparisons, educational timelines, and safety guidelines.
